race.description: Great Northern Brewing Co Mdn Plate
race.comment: BELINDA'S RUBI (9) returned in good order with a solid third over this track and trip in a career-best performance. Can feature again with natural improvement. ANY NEWS (1) has placed over this course and distance and will strip fitter third-up from the break. In the mix. KARMARDO (6) was good third-up and can keep things rolling. Blinkers go on and the 3kg claim gets him in nice and light. CHATSWORTH (2) showed encouraging signs on debut but has been less effective in his last two. Has been freshened with 44 days, looking to get things back on track.
